SELECT C.CATEGORY_ID, C.CATEGORY_NAME, , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS R WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM PRODUCTS P RIGHT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON P.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID
C.PARENT_ID = #parentId#
ORDER BY C.CATEGORY_NAME

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USERNAME, COUNT(O.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(O.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_SPENT FROM USERS U LEFT JOIN ORDERS O ON U.USER_ID = O.USER_ID AND O.STATUS != 'CANCELLED'
U.STATUS = #status#
U.ROLE_ID = #roleId#
GROUP BY U.USER_ID, U.USERNAME
COUNT(O.ORDER_ID) >= #minOrderCount#
SUM(O.TOTAL_AMOUNT) >= #minTotalSpent#
ORDER BY TOTAL_SPENT DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, C.CATEGORY_NAME, S.SUPPLIER_NAME, SUM(OI.QUANTITY) AS UNITS_SOLD, SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE) AS REVENUE FROM PRODUCTS P INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON P.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN SUPPLIERS S ON P.SUPPLIER_ID = S.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE O.STATUS = 'COMPLETED'
P.CATEGORY_ID = #categoryId#
O.ORDERED_AT >= #since#
GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, C.CATEGORY_NAME, S.SUPPLIER_NAME ORDER BY REVENUE DESC
SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USERNAME FROM USERS U WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.USER_ID = U.USER_ID )

SELECT USER_ID, USERNAME, 'TOP_SPENDER' AS SEGMENT FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID IN ( SELECT USER_ID FROM ORDERS GROUP BY USER_ID HAVING SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) >= #topSpenderThreshold# ) UNION SELECT USER_ID, USERNAME, 'RECENT_SIGNUP' AS SEGMENT FROM USERS WHERE CREATED_AT >= #recentSince#

SELECT W.WAREHOUSE_ID, W.WAREHOUSE_NAME, SUM(I.QUANTITY * P.PRICE) AS STOCK_VALUE FROM WAREHOUSES W INNER JOIN INVENTORY I ON W.WAREHOUSE_ID = I.WAREHOUSE_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON I.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY W.WAREHOUSE_ID, W.WAREHOUSE_NAME ORDER BY STOCK_VALUE DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, SA.CITY FROM ORDERS O INNER JOIN SHIPPING_ADDRESSES SA ON O.USER_ID = SA.USER_ID AND SA.IS_DEFAULT = 1 WHERE 1 = 1
#cities[]#
